topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The reduced antenna efficiency (41%) impacts link budget calculations by increasing required transmit power due to reduced gain, affecting system capacity and coverage probability. This necessitates additional amplification stages to maintain an acceptable signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), adding complexity and cost. The increased noise figure affects the system's capacity constraints, leading to a higher 'cost' in terms of performance reflected in reduced system capacity and coverage probability.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the importance of satellite efficiency, with Telesat's system achieving the highest efficiency (22.74 Gbps per satellite) compared to Spacex and Oneweb (5.36 Gbps and 2.17 Gbps respectively). The reduced antenna efficiency impacts not only link budget calculations but also overall system performance and capacity.
